## About
Dr. Viridiana Leyva, known to her patients as Dr. Viri, is a chiropractor in downtown Houston. She trained at Texas Chiropractic College in Pasadena and grew up around holistic medicine, which is what led her to help people improve their health without relying on medications or surgery.
Her care brings together spinal adjustments, rehab and nutrition, with the goal of finding and addressing the root cause of your pain. She sits down with each patient to explain what results to expect and what it will take to get there.
Dr. Viri speaks Spanish and is a member of the Hispanic Chiropractic Association, the Texas Chiropractic Association, the World Chiropractic Association and the American Chiropractic Association.

## Services
- Sports injuries: Chiropractic care for injuries from the field or the gym, including knee, back, neck, shoulder, ankle and hip injuries.
- Car accident chiropractic: Care for people recovering from car accidents and other personal injuries.
- Sciatica and lower back pain: Chiropractic treatment for sciatica and pain in the lower back.
- Shoulder pain: Help for shoulders that have become misaligned from a fall, lifting or carrying heavy bags.
- Prenatal chiropractic: Chiropractic care for expecting mothers.
- Rehab and nutrition: Adjustments combined with rehab and nutrition guidance to help you get moving again.
- Soft tissue work: Hands-on soft tissue work alongside chiropractic adjustments.

## FAQ
Q: Does Dr. Viri speak Spanish?
A: Yes. Dr. Viri is a Spanish-speaking chiropractor and can see patients in Spanish.

Q: What happens when I come in?
A: Dr. Viri sits down with you, explains what kind of results you can expect, and walks you through what it will take to get there.

Q: How do new patients book?
A: You can request an appointment through the website or give the office a call.
